label.en: Mushroom Picking: different options if the fungus was dug up

note.zh: 选项b仅在没有 fumongus_ours 标志时可选；选项c仅在有该标志时可选。
note.en: Option b is available without the fumongus_ours flag; option c only with it.

label.en: After The Spores Have Ears: fungus network active or not

label.en: Spore Connection: 10% chance of unrest, 90% surveillance

notes.zh: 殖民地2岁时（15/958）的随机事件；全局仅一次（fumongus_colony）；排除火山、方舟与荒野帝国。
notes.en: Random colony event at age 2 (15/958); once per game (fumongus_colony); excludes volcanic, ark and wilderness empires.

scope.zh: 蘑菇采集：未挖掘的真菌线、已挖掘的菌丝网线及其后续。
scope.en: Mushroom Picking: the not-yet-dug-up fungus line, the mycelium-network line and their follow-ups.

uncertain: fumongus_active / fumongus_dismantled / fumongus_ours are set by the Fumongus archaeological site (ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:9628-9745), a story owned by another reviewer; only the flags are referenced here.
